evaluated_models.training_objective: Next-token prediction with instruction fine-tuning and DPO/PPO alignment
evaluated_models.language_scope: Multilingual with high English proficiency on technical and logical reasoning
evaluated_models.nli_adaptation_method: Strict zero-shot closed-domain evidence-bounded structured prompt with JSON grammar schema enforcement
known_limitations: Higher per-query latency compared to small cross-encoders (1.0-2.8s vs ~20ms)
Requires active keep_alive to prevent OS unloading from RAM
Potential open-domain bias if prompt does not strictly constrain facts to Premise

evaluated_models.language_scope: Multilingual, specialized for compact code and logical reasoning
evaluated_models.nli_adaptation_method: Instruction-tuned closed-evidence verification with JSON schema constraint
known_limitations: Smaller capacity can occasionally struggle with deeply nested double negatives
Sensitive to prompt phrasing on long evidence contexts

evaluated_models.architecture: Disentangled Attention with Enhanced Masked Language Modeling (DeBERTa-v3)
evaluated_models.training_objective: Sequence pair classification on SNLI + MultiNLI (3 classes: contradiction, entailment, neutral)
evaluated_models.nli_adaptation_method: Native sequence classification head with 3 output logits
known_limitations: HuggingFace CDN download in local environment is bandwidth-constrained (~250 KB/s, ~20 min initial pull)
Sentence-transformers package triggers Windows C-runtime access violation (0xC0000005) necessitating raw transformers pipeline

primary_selected_tier2_engine: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (via Ollama local HTTP keep-alive daemon)
architectural_decision_rationale: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct is immediately available locally, exhibits 100% zero-shot precision on closed-evidence logic tests, perfectly distinguishes genuine curriculum contradiction from neutral unestablished facts, and avoids external network latency or binary runtime instability on Windows.
